item.title: Rob Reiner and Michele Singer's official cause of death released by medical examiner
item.description: Following the killings of renowned Hollywood director Rob Reiner and wife Michele Singer Reiner, their official cause of death was released by the L.A. Medical Examiner

item.title: Holiday cheer: Los Gatos Coffee Roasting Co. reopens after Thanksgiving car crash
item.description: Owner and founder Teri Hope says it's only 50% the usual capacity with a smaller staff, but it returns a sense of normality after a car crash that shuttered the Los Gatos institution for nearly a month.

item.title: New California laws going into effect in 2026 impact tortillas, streaming services and more
item.description: Plastic bag ban, wrong food deliveries, streaming services and more. Here are some big changes coming to California as 900 new laws go into effect in 2026.

item.title: Nearly a year after CA wildfires, homeowners struggle to recover amidst insurance challenges
item.description: A new report released this week highlights what experts describe as increasingly troubling trends in the insurance industry, with California homeowners hit especially hard.

item.title: 'Massive boom!': What to do if neighbor's tree falls on your house, yet insurance denies your claim?
item.description: A tree falls on your property, except... it's not your tree. It's technically on your neighbor's property. Yet, as a Castro Valley woman found out, she was stuck with the headache and the bill.

item.title: Winning numbers drawn for $1.26 billion Powerball jackpot
item.description: The winning numbers have been drawn for Wednesday's Powerball jackpot worth $1.26 billion.

item.title: Trump writes partisan plaques for predecessors in his newly installed Presidential Walk of Fame
item.description: President Donald Trump has added partisan and subjective plaques to a refashioned West Wing walkway he calls the Presidential Walk of Fame.

item.title: Greg Papa, legendary Bay Area sports announcer, to return to 49ers radio amid cancer battle
item.description: The radio voice of the San Francisco 49ers, Greg Papa, has been medically cleared to call the last two games of the season, and perhaps the playoffs at KNBR. Papa has been battling cancer and has been unable to broadcast games.

item.title: Activists hold Christmas carol protest at Concord Home Depot over ICE activity
item.description: Home Depot parking lots have often served as informal hiring site for day laborers, but now fewer people are showing up. Community activists rallied at Concord Home Depot, criticizing them of being complicit in ICE's operations.

item.title: House passes GOP health care bill that doesn't extend ACA subsidies
item.description: The House on Wednesday cleared a Republican health care package, 216-211, that does not extend the expiring Affordable Care Act (ACA) subsidies.
